roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.intro: Painfold cleans your customer feedback in your browser and finds what your customers are trying to get done, what frustrates them and what they wish for. Here is what is released, what is being built and what comes after.
roadmap.full: Read the full roadmap on GitHub

clean.name: Clean
clean.summary: Remove personal data from a feedback file in your browser and download the cleaned file.
points: Emails, phone numbers, IBANs and eight more kinds of personal data
Review and correct every finding before you download

names.name: Names
names.summary: Also find names and places, with a model that runs in your browser.
points: People and places in German and English
An interface in English and German
Published accuracy for every kind of personal data

jobs.name: Jobs, pains and gains
jobs.summary: See what your customers are trying to get done, what frustrates them and what they wish for.
points: Use your own AI key or a local model
See exactly what is sent before analysis starts
Every quote checked against your data

report.name: Report
report.summary: A report your team can act on in one meeting.
points: The three most important findings first
Segments and trends, when your file has them
Opportunities framed as “How might we…” questions

sources.name: Transcripts and documents
sources.summary: Clean and analyze interview transcripts and documents, not only tables.
points: Transcripts (TXT, VTT, SRT) first, then DOCX and PDF
Speakers replaced consistently, document metadata removed
Cleaned text as TXT or Markdown

launch.name: Launch
launch.summary: Try Painfold in 30 seconds, or run it on your own servers.
points: A demo with ready-made results, no API key needed
A Docker image for self-hosting with a local model

now.name: Now
now.hint: Being built for the next release.

clean.name: Clean
clean.summary: Remove personal data from a feedback file in your browser and download the cleaned file.

names.name: Names
names.summary: Also find names and places, with a model that runs in your browser, and use Painfold in English or German.

jobs.name: Jobs, pains and gains
jobs.summary: See what your customers are trying to get done, what frustrates them and what they wish for, with an AI you choose.

workspace.name: Workspace redesign
workspace.summary: Import, Review and Analyze in one workspace: the four steps at the top, filters at the side, tables you can sort.

report.name: Report
report.summary: A report your team can act on in one meeting: the main findings first, segments and trends, and questions for your team.

landing.name: New start page
landing.summary: A start page that shows, step by step, what is checked in your browser and that nothing leaves it.

namesMore.name: Better name detection
namesMore.summary: Nicknames, names at the start of a sentence and more name particles, measured on a new, independent test set.

transcripts.name: Interview transcripts
transcripts.summary: Clean transcripts as TXT, VTT or SRT, with speakers replaced consistently.

documents.name: DOCX and PDF documents
documents.summary: Clean documents, with their metadata, comments and tracked changes removed.

docker.name: Docker image
docker.summary: Run Painfold on your own servers, with a local model, offline.

engine.name: Painfold Engine
engine.summary: An optional self-hosted service that runs the analysis with a local model, for teams that host Painfold themselves.

mcp.name: MCP server
mcp.summary: Painfold as a privacy gate for AI assistants: files are cleaned on your machine before an assistant sees them.
